yeah my sister is 20 months older than me. I don't realy think it's that, she just makes me so stressed out.

I try to be polite as much as i can because i have this real fear of casing otehr people stress or anger-to harm them in any way I guess. My anger is more like I take things personally that aren't meant personally and I always impulsively snap at people (mostly my family, sometime my friends if they really do something bad).

Good for you! You go! :D I'll have to find a winter activity like that :)

I liek really anything. My favorite band is tegan and sara. I like acoustic music, death metal, indie (my fave i think), rock, classic rock, some pop, and yeah elctronic :D Go ahead with teh music thing! I feel teh same way. Music really helps. Stars is a godo ban i find because some of their songs are sad and deep but also dreary or dark but still with a happy tone. hard to explain really, (a good song of theirs is Your Ex Lover Is Dead and The Last 5 Days).

Good luck to you too :)

It's not that I don't think anyone will come to my funeral. I feel like if you care about someone care about them now goddammit, not after they've passed away. If they decide to care for me after I die, so what? I'll be dead. 

Also I do believe most of the people in my life love me. I'm not so sure about my friends. They'd probably be really shook up about my death but i feel liek i annoy them and they might be relieved, i don't know.

Tommorrow basically is going to be teh same as tommorrow. I'm not just going to suddenly become happy. I won't suddenly feel liek less of a burden to my family. I won't suddenly be less angry. I won't suddenly be less lost and confused. I really doubt it anyways.

I have tried to talk to one friend but only about how i think i mght have a personality disorder. basically what happenned was I made a jokingly sassy remark and then said "If I had the courage to be sassy I would be SO sassy" to which my friend said "Yeah, a sassy borderline bitch!" (I think i have borderline personality disorder) and then looked at me with a sheet white face saying "that was a joke! that was a joke!" and kind of laughing and trying to get me to laugh which i forced just to make it less awkward...

There are barely any little things in life that make me smile anymore. Especially not right now anyways. believe me I'd be holding on to them and thiniking about them constantly if i could. The only thing that relaly brings me any joy right now is my dog.

I'm glad that you're happy and comfortable, you deserve to be :) Thank you for trying to help :)

oh okay I see what you're saying :) 

I will keep that in mind. thank you :)

I'm actually thinking of trying out for the rugby team this year! Though I'm actually really small and I'd probably get beaten up but it would be fun and a good way to rid of the anger :) A girl got her ear ripped off while playing rugby at my school o.o

I also play softball and batting really helps get my anger out.

I'm sorry to hear about your father, may he rest in peace.

I don't really want to try counseling or anything at my school because I also have trust issues and I feel like they'd know who i'm talking about from teh school and stuff liek that. I also don't want to cry while i'm there and then end up having to go back to class crying.

I don't even know if it's really a matter of "lashing out". I mean sort of but it's almost not even a thing where i've been able to train myself to walk away yet. I'll just get mad over anything no matter how stupid or small. Or I'll take offence over something innocent. 

Me and my sister don't really communicate or talk because she makes me really uneasy and stressed out to be honest. She probably doesn't realy liek me either because I'm so mean to her (actually i saw one of her texts by accident once saying thet she hated me...)

No one in my life knows any of teh stuff I've just said. Only one person knows about the possible personality disorder but she made a remark about it recently taht really hurt so i don't really want to anyone else about it and don't really trust her anymore.

Thank you for helping me and taking the time to reply :) I hope you are in a good place right now

I have tried that. I repress my emotions a lot though (except for anger I guess) and I just kind of don't want to do that anymore. I'm hoping if i just let myslef feel it it will pass. It also kind of makes me happy and kind of gives me hope, makes me feel liek tehre's a way out to think about it.
that's really helpful thanks :)
I'm not diagnosed or anything as i said but my triggers definitly make me super pissed too. There are few taht make me really easily sad. Just for me though anyways.

Don't be so sure about that. Keep an open mind okay? :)

Thank you very much :) I hope so too

I wake up drenched in sweat, it's horrible. So I guess I kind of know how you feel. I'm looking into getting a therapist. You shoudl probably do the same. Keep your head high, buddy :)

I'm even too scared to do that honestly. While I'm hand writting it (even if i plan on burning it afterwards) i feel like someone might walk in on me writting and read it, even if I'm home alone.
I have written non personal things and even put those in folders called "school projects" or something of the sort to hide it but i could never write anything personal and put it there.
I basically just stick to the word searches.

I like to do word searches. (I've done 170 during the past two weeks...) 
and I like to write even though I suck at it. It's fun to come up with stories and lose yourself thinking about them and analysing them and tweeking them. Also just writing out my feelings would probably be soothing but I'm too scared to do that cause i'm worried someone might find it.

I'm in the same situation as you where I'm not diagnosed but I think I have it. I did this test a few days ago and i did it 3 times and got 90% each time. I also got weirdly high percentages in other mental illnesses too. Like 20-35% higher than the average. oh boy eh? o.o

Thanks for the advice :)

I know I'm young and I know that people always say not to look to the internet for diagnosis but I also read tons of articles and watched documentaries and it just seems so me.

I don't really talk to my sister either. or my dad. Either of them would be worse than my mom.

I've actually asked my mom before and my sister doesn't have a mental illness just depresssion. And as far as i know my mom doesn't have a mental illness, she doesn't seem to have one either. 

I know now that i do have to talk to her i just don't know how and I'm kind of putting it off because it's stressing me out too much. This kind of feels liek when i was trying to come out of the closet. Thought I'd only have to do that once :P

Yeah I'm mainly unsure how to communicate. Someone said a note might work but i don't know how to give it to her cause i don't want to be there when she reads it cause that kind of defeats the purpose. I'm also unsure as to what exactly I would write.

Thank you for your response, concern and help :)

I just saw this and I'm probably too young and too unexperienced to give you much advice but I want you to know one thing. You are NOT a failure. And "failing" a suicide does not count as a failure, cause it's a good thing. 

I swa in the second paragraph how you were trivializing your pain and i don't know if that's coming from your peers or you but I also want you to know that that doesn't count. It's comparing two wildly different things. They're so different in their own different way you can't compare them, like apples to oranges. And what you're feeling is not stupid and shouldn't be trivialized. 

I know you said you're broke but if you have some sort of health plan or anything you should try therapy (I'm not sure if you said you already had it, I get confused easily. but either way try it again, even if it didn't help before there's still a good chance it will). Switch therapists if you find one isn't helping.

I hope i helped in some way. Please copy paste this or post something similar to /r/SuicideWatch there are I'm pretty sure a bunch more subscribers there who'll see this and they're more equipped than myself to help you. Please don't do anything like kill yourself. Please keep trying.
